description: The Dell 15 (2026), starting at Rs. 69,699, focuses on delivering a steady and practical everyday experience. Powered by the Intel Core Ultra 5 225H processor with 16GB RAM, it handles regular work and multitasking smoothly without drawing attention to itself. The keyboard is comfortable, and usability remains a strong point throughout. However, the display lacks vibrancy, the plastic build feels basic, and the battery life of around four to five hours limits unplugged use. It works best as a dependable daily work machine rather than an all-rounder.
title: Dell 15 (2026) Review: Practical, Reliable, and a Little Too Safe?

description: Samsung Galaxy A57 and Galaxy A37 were recently launched in India. The two smartphones retail at the higher end within the Galaxy A series. Both ship with Samsung’s Exynos chipsets, offering decent performance, paired with the same 5,000mAh batteries and 45W wired fast charging support as last year. This might not come as a surprise, but the company has also kept the triple rear camera systems of the phones unchanged, a strategy that has seemingly worked well with the flagship Galaxy S series models. Here’s our review of the two phones.
title: Samsung Galaxy A57 and A37 Review: Is Samsung’s ‘A-Game’ Worth the Price?

description: Huawei Watch Buds 2 has launched in China with a 2-in-1 design that combines a smartwatch and built-in earbuds. It features a 1.5-inch LTPO AMOLED display with 3,000 nits brightness and supports adaptive earbuds with noise reduction. The device includes multiple sensors for heart rate, sleep, and stress tracking, along with AI-based sports analysis. It supports Bluetooth, NFC, and GNSS. Battery life is claimed to last up to three days, with earbuds offering up to four hours of playback.
title: Huawei Watch Buds 2 Launched With Built-in Earbuds, LTPO Display: Price, Features

description: Motorola’s Razr 2026 series could launch in North America on May 21, according to a Dealabs leak. The lineup may include the Razr 2026, Razr+ 2026, Ultra, and Fold models, with prices starting at $799.99. The Razr 2026 is expected to use a Dimensity 7450X chip and a 120Hz display, while the Razr+ 2026 may offer a Snapdragon 8s Gen 3 SoC and a 165Hz screen. Both could feature dual 50-megapixel cameras, Android 16, and improved battery and charging support.
title: Motorola Razr 2026, Razr+ 2026 Launch Date, Price, Specifications Leaked

description: Blue Origin successfully reused a New Glenn booster for the first time, marking a milestone in reusable rockets. However, a second-stage issue led to the loss of a satellite, highlighting challenges in achieving full mission reliability.
title: Blue Origin Reuses New Glenn Booster for First Time in Historic Launch

description: Apple may delay its redesigned MacBook Pro due to ongoing shortages of RAM and SSD components. The company had planned to launch the upgraded model between late 2026 and early 2027, but the timeline could now shift further into 2027. The new MacBook Pro is expected to feature an OLED display, touchscreen support, and M6 Pro and M6 Max chips. Meanwhile, the current MacBook Pro (2026) offers a Liquid Retina XDR display, M5 series chips, up to 128GB RAM, and starts at Rs. 2,49,900 in India.
title: Apple's Redesigned MacBook Pro Said to Be Delayed Due to Supply Shortages

description: OpenAI seems to be undergoing a transition phase. As many as three senior leaders of the company have announced their departure this week, hinting at a change in structure and a massive reorganisation at play. Most notably, Bill Peebles, the Head of Sora, and Srinivas Narayanan, the CTO of B2B Applications, are leaving the San Francisco-based artificial intelligence (AI) giant.
title: OpenAI’s Sora Chief, CTO Announce Departure Amid Company’s Growing Enterprise Focus

description: Poco C81 series will be launched in India on April 23, the Xiaomi sub-brand revealed on Monday. The lineup is confirmed to include two models, dubbed Poco C81 and Poco C81x. Both smartphones will be available for purchase in India via Flipkart. Additionally, the Xiaomi sub-brand has also revealed the design and battery capacities of the upcoming handsets. While the Poco C81 will be backed by a 6,300mAh battery, the Poco C81x will pack a 5,200mAh battery. The standard model will also feature a dual rear camera unit.
title: Poco C81, Poco C81x India Launch Date Revealed Along With Design and Key Specifications

description: From the newly announced AI Tech Lab to Rufus, Zeba Khan, Director – Consumer Electronics, Amazon India, explains how the e-commerce giant is tackling 'cognitive load' for India’s tech buyers.
title: Cutting Through the Noise: How Amazon India is Reinventing AI Discovery

description: Huawei Pura X Max has been launched in China as the company’s first wide-folding handset. The smartphone was unveiled on Monday during the tech firm’s April 2026 launch event, along with the new Huawei Pura 90 series, Huawei Watch Fit 5 lineup, and the Huawei Watch Buds 2. The new foldable will be available for purchase in the country starting April 25 via the Huawei China online store. The phone is offered in five colour options and four storage configurations. It sports a 5.4-inch cover display and a 7.7-inch foldable screen.
title: Huawei Pura X Max Launched as Company’s First Wide Foldable With 5,300mAh Battery: Price, Features

description: Nukkad Naatak tells the story of two friends whose punishment turns into a life-changing journey of empathy and social awareness.
title: Nukkad Naatak OTT Release Date: When and Where to Watch This Social Drama Online?

description: Nee Forever explores how a fake online relationship slowly transforms into a deep emotional bond amid life’s challenges.
title: Nee Forever OTT Release Date: When and Where to Watch This Tamil Romantic Drama Online?

description: The Huawei Pura 90 series was launched in China on Monday. The latest lineup comprises three models — Huawei Pura 90, Pura 90 Pro, and Pura 90 Pro Max. All of the latest Huawei handsets are powered by the company’s proprietary Kirin 9000 series chipsets, with the Pura 90 Pro and Pro Max variants featuring Kirin 9030S SoC under the hood. The Huawei Pura 90 series runs on HarmonyOS 6.1, which has been developed independently of Android.
title: Huawei Pura 90 Pro Max Launched With 200-Megapixel Telephoto Camera Alongside Huawei Pura 90, Pura 90 Pro

description: Anthropic, on Friday, introduced a new product focused on design and visual outputs. Dubbed Claude Design, the latest creation by Anthropic Labs is an artificial intelligence (AI)-powered tool that can generate website mockups, design prototypes, slides, one-pagers, and more, based on a single natural-language prompt. The outputs are editable, and the user can take control and refine the final version using multiple tools provided within the experience.
title: Anthropic Introduces Claude Design, an AI Tool to Generate Visual Prototypes and Pitch Decks

description: The Competition Commission of India (CCI) said in an April 8 order that Apple has not submitted details of its financials and its views on the investigation since October 2024, and instead cited a separate case pending in the Delhi High Court where the company has challenged India's entire antitrust penalty law.
title: Apple Withholds Data in India Antitrust Case, CCI Sets Final Hearing

description: Huawei has launched the Watch Fit 5 and Watch Fit 5 Pro in China with AMOLED displays, improved health tracking, and long battery life. The standard model features a 1.82-inch screen, while the Pro offers a larger 1.92-inch display with higher brightness and premium materials. Both support GNSS, Bluetooth calling, and multiple sensors, with the Pro adding ECG and diving support. The watches offer up to 10 days of battery life and run on HarmonyOS, with pricing starting at CNY 1,099 (roughly Rs. 14,900).
title: Huawei Watch Fit 5, Watch Fit 5 Pro Launched With AMOLED Screens, HarmonyOS and Up to 10 Days Battery Life

description: Adobe has introduced CX Enterprise at its Summit 2026 conference, an AI-driven platform designed to manage customer experience workflows using agents, reusable skills and data integration. Built on Adobe Experience Platform, the system supports enterprise use cases such as marketing automation and personalisation, with interoperability across major cloud and AI providers.
title: Adobe Introduces CX Enterprise, an Agentic AI Platform to Automate Customer Experience for Businesses

description: Infinix GT 50 Pro will be launched in select global markets on April 24, the company has announced. The smartphone will be positioned as a gaming smartphone, which has been teased to feature pressure-sensitive shoulder triggers. The handset will also be equipped with a liquid cooling system for thermal management. The upcoming Infinix GT 50 Pro will also be equipped with a 1.5K flat AMOLED display, offering up to 144Hz of refresh rate, with support for 144 fps gaming. It will be sold in at least two colour options.
title: Infinix GT 50 Pro Global Launch Date Announced; Will Debut With Liquid Cooling, Pressure-Sensitive Triggers

description: Toshiba on Monday expanded its TV lineup with the launch of the Z670SP series in India. It is the company’s first MiniLED offering in the country that has front-firing speakers. The TV is available in five sizes, with all models supporting Dolby Vision and Atmos. The Toshiba Z670SP series is said to come with a native 144Hz refresh rate for smoother motion clarity, while the REGZA Intelligence is an AI-powered system that can automatically adjust picture and sound settings in real time.
title: Toshiba Z670SP MiniLED TV Series Launched in India With Up to 100-Inch 144Hz Screens: Price, Specifications

description: Resident Evil Requiem is confirmed to get new content, including a mini game in May. A new leak suggests that the mini game could be the arcade-style Mercenaries mode seen in previous Resident Evil games. Resident Evil Requiem will also get a story expansion sometime in the future.
title: Resident Evil Requiem Could Get Mercenaries Arcade Mode in May, Leak Suggests

description: OnePlus on Monday announced the launch date of its upcoming smartphones, the OnePlus Nord CE 6 and Nord CE 6 Lite, in India. Both handsets are expected to join the brand’s latest mid-range lineup, which already comprises the recently introduced OnePlus Nord 6. Ahead of launch, OnePlus has also teased several features of the upcoming Nord CE 6. It is teased to be equipped with a 1.5K 144Hz display. The handset will be powered by a Snapdragon 7 series chipset.
title: OnePlus Nord CE 6, Nord CE 6 Lite India Launch Date Announced; Snapdragon 7s Gen 4 Chip Confirmed

description: Dell 15 (2026) has been launched in India as the latest addition to the Round Rock-based tech giant’s laptop lineup. The laptop is set to go on sale in the country via the Dell India online store, Dell authorised offline stores, and other multi-brand stores. The new Dell 15 model is configurable up to an Intel Core Ultra 7 255H processor, paired with an integrated Intel GPU. The laptop can also be purchased with the Intel Core Ultra 5 225H processor option. It is equipped with a 15.6-inch Full-HD display, offering up to 60Hz of refresh rate and 300 nits of brightness. The laptop also features up to 1TB of onboard storage and up to 16GB of RAM.
title: Dell 15 (2026) Launched in India With Up to Intel Core Ultra 7 and 15.6-Inch Display: Price, Features

description: The ongoing global memory shortage has shaken up the consumer tech market, with the rising component costs driving up the selling prices of devices such as smartphones, laptops, gaming consoles, and more. A new report now claims that it could take until 2030 before the supply matches the demand. One of the biggest DRAM suppliers globally, SK Hynix, is reportedly planning to bring up a new fabrication plant, but it is said that the focus would be on HBM.
title: Global Memory Shortage Could Persist Until 2030 as Suppliers Prioritise AI Data Centres: Report

description: Realme is reportedly preparing the C81 for India, with leaks revealing 4GB+64GB and 4GB+128GB variants in Glacier Blue and Storm Black. The device carries model number RMX5388, linking it to the Realme Note 80, suggesting a rebrand. It may feature a 6.74-inch HD+ 90Hz display, Unisoc T7250 chip, and Android 15. Expected highlights include a 6,300mAh battery, MIL-STD-810H durability, and basic cameras, indicating a focus on reliability rather than performance.
title: Realme C81 Said to Launch in India Soon; Key Specifications, Colours, Storage Leaked

description: Oppo Find X9s has been spotted on the Geekbench benchmarking platform with the model number CPH2873, a tipster claims. The handset has been listed on the website with an octa core MediaTek Dimensity 9500s chipset. The smartphone is said to ship with Android 16 and 12GB of RAM. The chipset will reportedly be paired with a Mali-G925-Immortalis MC12 GPU. This comes a day before the launch of the smartphone in select global markets. The Oppo Find X9 Ultra will accompany the upcoming Find X9s.
title: Oppo Find X9s Key Specifications, Performance Details Spotted on Geekbench Ahead of Launch

description: Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 was crowned Best Game at the BAFTA Games Awards 2026 on Friday. The game also won in two other categories, ending up with three wins from 12 nominations. Narrative-driven adventure game Dispatch won three awards, too. Here's the full list of winners from the ceremony.
title: Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 Crowned Best Game at BAFTA Games Awards 2026: Full List of Winners

description: Google is reportedly exploring a partnership with semiconductor company Marvell Technology. As per the report, the Mountain View-based tech giant is in talks with the company to develop two new artificial Intelligence (AI) chipsets for its workload requirements. There is reportedly no deal in place, but the companies have initiated formal discussions around the topic.
title: Google Reportedly Exploring AI Inference Chip Partnership With Marvell Technology

description: The Huawei Pura 90 series is scheduled to be launched in China on April 20. The upcoming lineup is expected to comprise four phones, including the Pura 90 Pro Max and the Pura X Max, with the latter being a foldable. Ahead of their anticipated debut, a tipster has leaked key specifications of the Huawei Pura 90, Pura 90 Pro, and Pura 90 Pro Max. The handsets are expected to differ in terms of display size, battery capacity, and camera hardware.
title: Huawei Pura 90, Pura 90 Pro and Pura 90 Pro Max Key Specifications Leaked Ahead of China Launch

description: OnePlus Ace 6 Ultra will be launched in China on April 28, the smartphone maker announced on Monday. Additionally, the tech firm has revealed a new OnePlus Strix gaming controller for the upcoming handset. The gaming controller will be attached to the back of the smartphone. The OnePlus Ace 6 Ultra is set to arrive as the third model in the Ace 6 lineup, which currently includes the OnePlus Ace 6 and OnePlus Ace 6T. The company has teased the design of the phone, revealing that the handset will feature a dual rear camera unit. It appears with a flat rear panel with the Ace branding.
title: OnePlus Ace 6 Ultra Launch Date Announced; New OnePlus-Branded Gaming Controller Will Tag Along

description: Xiaomi’s upcoming flagship, likely the Xiaomi 18 Pro Max, has surfaced in new leaks. It may feature a Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 Pro chip and a large 6.9-inch flat display. The phone is tipped to include dual speakers, enhanced haptics, and a 200-megapixel main camera with advanced HDR. It could also offer a dual 200-megapixel setup with a periscope lens. Expected highlights include an 8,500mAh battery, 100W wired and 50W wireless charging, and Android 17-based HyperOS 4.
title: Xiaomi 18 Pro Max Specifications Leak; Might Feature Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 Pro Chip, 6.9-Inch Display

description: Apple is said to have already teased a major overhaul for Siri ahead of WWDC 2026, which is scheduled for later this year. According to a seasoned journalist, early hints point towards a redesigned interface and deeper AI integration in iOS 27. The Cupertino-based tech giant’s official teaser artwork for this year’s developer conference has drawn attention for its visual elements, which reportedly offer clues about the next evolution of its voice assistant, although Apple has yet to confirm any details.
title: Apple’s WWDC 2026 Teaser Hints at Siri Overhaul With New UI, AI Features: Report

description: The OnePlus Nord 6 was launched in India and select global markets earlier this month, and the rumour mill suggests it could be joined by two more models. A OnePlus handset, believed to be the OnePlus Nord CE 6, has been discovered on a benchmarking site. The listing not only reveals the purported handset’s moniker but also sheds light on some of its key specifications. It is seen with 8GB of RAM.
title: OnePlus Nord CE 6 Listed on Geekbench With Snapdragon 7s Gen 4 Chip, 8GB RAM
